Cube Storage Pioneers

Little Robots, Big Business

Since its inception in 1996, AutoStore™ has worked to improve warehouse efficiency. Today, the company’s key value proposition is to deliver an easy-to-use software powered cubic automatic storage and retrieval ecosystem.

The AutoStore solution is modular and flexible, and can automate any warehouse. The system offers a superior customer value proposition across operating metrics, ESG scores, and customer economics.
‍

elements.contents: ... that the Mingxing Film Company (logo pictured) paid off a gangster so that it could release Fate in Tears and Laughter?

elements.title: Donum Montford (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that brickmason Donum Montford likely purchased his own freedom from slavery and became a prominent slave-owner?

elements.title: threatened legal action (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Brazil's Ministry of Education threatened legal action against the Portuguese Wikipedia over the article for its minister?

elements.title: a Japanese man (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a Japanese man raised more than 1,000 Korean orphans during the Japanese occupation of Korea?

elements.title: Valdez Creek (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that although over half a million troy ounces of gold have been mined from Valdez Creek, surveys suggest that more is likely undiscovered?

elements.title: Katerina Clark (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Katerina Clark wrote "a brave and intelligent study of the Soviet novel"?

elements.title: Close to You (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that during Frank Ocean's performance of "Close to You" at FYF Fest in 2017, giant screens live-streamed Brad Pitt acting out a phone conversation backstage?

elements.title: Aon v Australian National University (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Aon v Australian National University overturned a precedent that encouraged litigation-prolonging amendments to pleadings?

elements.title: Star Trucker (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that vehicles in Star Trucker still look like American semi-trucks from the 1970s, despite having technology such as warp drivers and maglocks?
